description: Owner decision 2026-11-25 (step 4b): on an encoded clip the Highlights and Shadows sliders drive the node chain's log highlight / log shadow wheels (EncodedToneBridge appends a synthetic node to the chain wire, preview and export alike through EncodedSource.renderFrame); the legacy tone stages 9-20 stay off for encoded clips and MCRAW is untouched. They did nothing before: frame luma identical at Highlights -50 on a Mi-Log 4K60 and an 8K clip. The node's default region (DI 0.142 / 0.552) barely touches ordinary SDR-range footage (Highlights -100 moved no pixel by more than 3 levels in the app), so the synthetic node narrows it to 0.35 / 0.45 around mid grey. Device, Mi-Log frame 0: Highlights -100 luma 122.4 -> 118.8, 18% of pixels change by more than 8 levels (max 35); Shadows +100 luma +6.0, 24% of pixels by more than 20; both back to 0 reproduce the neutral frame exactly (max diff 0).
